value.how: for each merge, a scratch worktree at parent 1, git merge --no-commit --no-ff of parent 2, then python -m cairn.tools.artifact check with GIT_INDEX_FILE unset and CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS naming that worktree (script pmc_retro.sh, output kept with the READY)
value.saw: Re-running the artifact check over the past lands: of the 7 cairn merges in the last 40 commits at 9c2edb871, 5 pass (rc 0) under the merged tree's own check, and 2 (ae2a5c1c1, 2db0b333b) conflicted on a validation, so they were committed through git commit and pre-commit ran then. Of the 8 commons merges at 71aa3e42, all 8 pass under today's cairn check. No past land would have been refused. The harness is not hollow: one hand-edited ticket staged into the 62acedaeb merge index is refused with rc 2.
